snippet.title: ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
That’s where the Wings of Theve comes in… the legendary savior. 

ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE releases October 2nd, 2026!
Pre-order now to unlock the F-14A aircraft and exclusive access to ACE COMBAT ZERO: THE BELKAN WAR: https://acecombat.com/preorder

The Deluxe Edition of ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE includes:
• Base Game
• 3 days of Early Access
• Customizable Cosmetic Set
• Premium Ace Pass Plus Voucher 

Take to the skies in style with the Joker Flight Pack, including all content from the Deluxe Edition, plus an Official Artbook, 2 LP Vinyl Records, Slipcase, and Slipmat!

#ACECOMBAT8 #WingsOfTheve
